title: Or sits beside Shorten the cut the way the transition mock draws it
goal: At a cut with no spare frames, the Properties panel offers "Or · Shorten the cut by 0.4s". The mock puts Or on the left with the button beside it; at the panel's usual width the full button does not fit, so today Or sits on its own line above it. Decide whether to keep the full words and icon on a second line or trim the button to fit beside.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transition-wt.html #rowForce (irow, Or + btn secondary sm with ic-swap). App: TransitionInspector.shorten(_:), a VideoKit.FieldRow with a .fixedSize() button, so PanelFieldRowLayout stacks it under Or when the 76pt label column plus the ~173pt button exceeds the row (~236pt at default dock width). Without the icon at 10.5pt it is ~145pt, which would fit beside. Picture: queue/audits/2026-10-15-shorten-the-cut-1b-the-offer-sc.png.
acceptance: The user has picked how the Or row is laid out on the decision card
At the panel's default width the row matches the picked layout, with the button's words never cut off

log.note: Waiting on the decision card about the Or row layout

decision "At a cut with no spare frames, how should the Or row with Shorten the cut sit in Properties?" resolved: Or on its own line, full button under it (Taken as recommended: the user, 2026-10-19, said there were too many cards, most did not matter and they could not follow them. Change it later only if they complain about the result)

digest 2026-10-20: the card picked 'Or on its own line, full button under it', which is the layout that already ships, so nothing is built. shorten-the-cut-for-a-dissolve-walk passed in the 2026-10-20 full sweep (982 of 986).
